newsitem.title: HONG KONG: United Pac makes cash offer for HK Toy.
newsitem.headline: United Pac makes cash offer for HK Toy.

text.p: United Pacific Industries Ltd is making an unconditional cash offer for all outstanding Hong Kong Toy Centre International Ltd shares at HK$0.90 each, the companies said in a joint statement on Monday.

United Pacific said it made the general offer after its subsidiary Pacific Margin International Ltd completed the purchase of a 166.76 million shares or 47.3 percent stake in Hong Kong Toy Centre at HK$0.90 per share on April 11.
Pacific Margin's stake in Hong Kong Toy Centre had been raised to 60.7 percent as at April 11, the statement said.
Last month, Pacific Margin agreed to buy the 47.3 percent stake from Hong Kong Toy Centre's controlling shareholders Victor Lo and Esther Leung.
It said it would make a general offer for Hong Kong Toy Centre shares on completion of the share deal.
Shares of Hong Kong Toy Centre edged up one cent to HK$0.89 at midday. United Pacific shares eased HK$0.03 to HK$1.14.
